meta.title: Magpie real route
meta.description: Show the real upstream model behind a magpie routing group directly below the composer (the text follows the DSH UI language: "magpie real route" in English, "magpie 真实路由" in Chinese). The Host half tags each magpie inference with X-Magpie-Session and reads /v1/magpie/route for this session's current/last route, including an in-flight request's already-picked target; trace is the first-paint fallback. The dock line refreshes every 15 seconds and on click; it reads the package Host half's same-origin route /plugins/magpie-route/route, so the browser never calls the gateway directly. Read-only: it sends no model request and does not change routing; the magpie gateway must be running. No configuration is required: the Host half discovers the gateway from DSH's active magpie provider (each inference's request.baseURL, with llm-pi-ai's providers.magpie.baseURL for the first paint, and http://127.0.0.1:3425 as the last resort); only override config.baseURL when you need an address DSH does not know about. This plugin adds no command and no agent tool.
